notes: 101 inferred floorplates and 44 curtain-wall assemblies. Repeated panels and members retain individual identities, type families and materials. Full EXPRESS validation and all 2,622 represented leaf elements passed conversion; floor winding and volumes were also checked. The assumed height is 508 m; rectangular floor footprints and hidden depth are estimates, not measured building plans.
limits: Geometry conversion is not a watertightness, clash, constructability or downstream application certification. Floor plans and unseen geometry are inferred. Original photographic evaluation is preserved.
